saw_lines: Gold buyers compare the coin, the dealer and the fees before they trust a checkout.
So the sale is won or lost in the ad itself, before the webinar, when price, shipping and proof are missing.
Your site shows 2700+ reviews, yet 0 of 20 ads carry that count. Print 2700+ reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 24 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 2700+ reviews, yet 0 of 20 ads carry that count, so cold viewers have no proof to trust a webinar invite. Print 2700+ reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

Your site offers free shipping on most orders, yet 0 of 20 ads mention shipping or delivery, so new buyers must guess how the coins arrive. Answer that in the first line of each ad, naming free shipping on most orders.

Your homepage shows prices from $1 to $20, yet 0 of 20 ads mention price or cost, so a cold viewer clicks through without knowing the price. Lead one ad with those prices and test it against webinar ads.
One exact copy runs in 7 of 18 ads, so repeat viewers hear the same words and skip them. Keep the body copy, then change the opening line and the creative in each of those 7 ads so each reads new.

ads_1: Fresh hooks on price, shipping and review proof, replacing the Locked Out copy
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Twitter and Youtube, your linked channels
